title: GTA6 Monday Morning Mural Update Sparks Fan Speculation
description: A recent Reddit post highlights a GTA6-related mural update with regular progress shared by the project manager on Instagram, sparking community speculation.

content:
## GTA6 Monday Morning Mural Update Sparks Fan Speculation

As anticipation continues to build around Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster, the global gaming community remains constantly on the lookout for any hint, clue, or piece of art related to the title. Recently, a post on the r/GTA6 subreddit brought a fresh community discussion regarding a street mural project.

### Tracking the Mural Progress via Instagram

According to a submission by Reddit user /u/Salty_Scrotum, fans who follow the Instagram account birntoutstudio appear to have access to regular updates regarding the painting process. The user noted that the account holder serves as the project manager for the mural, sharing ongoing progress as the artwork takes shape. This social media activity quickly caught the attention of dedicated fans eager for any new content.

### Community Speculation on Jason and Lucia

Fueling the excitement within the thread, the original poster expressed a feeling that players might get a glimpse of Jason and Lucia by the end of the day. However, it is important to emphasize that this information stems entirely from community observations and speculative discussion. At this time, Rockstar Games has not issued any official statement or confirmation connecting this mural project to GTA6.

### Editor's Take

The GTA6 community's ability to track grassroots details never ceases to amaze. While this mural update and the speculation surrounding Jason and Lucia remain unconfirmed community rumors, they highlight the incredible passion of the fanbase. Always take community findings with a grain of salt while waiting for official updates.
